name: happyface
description: happyface's plugins for GitHub Copilot: the spec workflow, Flutter conventions and decision reviews.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: A project specification as a graph of units, with a CLI and a ticket-driven workflow.

plugins.name: flutter
plugins.description: Flutter conventions, core rules and pattern skills (cubits, models, networking, forms, navigation, UI, tests).

plugins.name: decide
plugins.description: Make decisions on a visual page: what the change is about, then each option as a picture of its result, with its cost.

plugins.name: visualize
plugins.description: Explain a concept as a bold visual storyboard, or a code change as a brief: what it does, its real code, where to look and every file.

plugins.name: visualize-interactive
plugins.description: A storyboard or change brief you can question: click any part, a line of code included, and a small, locked-down model answers from checked notes.
